historical_settings.map: raw28x28 patch distances ->224x224 CPU FP32 bilinear align_corners=false; no smoothing/normalization
historical_settings.mask: raw nonzero, direct224 nearest; retain anomalous image label if tiny mask erases; raw empty/mismatched masks fail
historical_settings.undefined_metrics: fail and preserve evidence; never silently drop a category
historical_settings.checkpoint: every8images, each task boundary, pause and true stream end; no task flush or reset; finalize once only after all3599images

bootstrap.superiority: both primary paired lower CI bounds >0
bootstrap.degenerate_pixel_draw: AP=0 if resampled positive pixel mass is zero; never redraw/drop
bootstrap.noninferiority: both paired lower CI bounds strictly greater than -0.02

historical_settings.failure_policy: technical/nonfinite failures stop and export; no auto-retune, early stopping or score changes after test
